items.title: Advancements in intraoperative monitoring techniques in neurosurgical practice: a systematic review
items.why_it_matters: Abstract Background Intraoperative monitoring (IOM) has become a vital component of contemporary neurosurgery, significantly reducing neurological deficits and improving surgical outcomes. This systematic review aims to evaluate recent advancements in IOM techniques in neurosurgical practice.

items.title: Constant-round quantum advantage in communication complexity for total functions
items.why_it_matters: We show that there exists a total function for which there is a polynomial gap between the randomized and the constant-round quantum communication complexity. Previously, such a separation was known only for quantum protocols using polynomially many rounds.
